bond_beats.title: Hospitality despite his hurry
bond_beats.reading: He wants to leave because of work/time; she insists he stay for juice and sends him to play with Pappu.

bond_beats.title: Joyful arrival, concealed earlier reason and lunch-time hurry
bond_beats.reading: He arrives joyfully. His explanation for the earlier departure is explicitly labelled a lie. He has one lunch hour and wants payment quickly; she realizes she has never fed him a meal.

bond_beats.title: Invitation, floor seating and being moved by consideration
bond_beats.reading: He initially mentions his mother’s food and refuses the dining table. Dhika chooses to sit on the floor with him and explains she wants to eat together; he feels moved.

bond_beats.reading: He praises her cooking; she credits his mother too. They talk about family and he helps carry dishes to the sink.

bond_beats.title: First beauty compliment from Chotu and her response
bond_beats.reading: He notices her sleeveless dress and says she looks beautiful. She is shy; the narrator identifies this as his first beauty compliment and notes she likes compliments.

bond_beats.title: Explicit trust and its stated reasoning
bond_beats.reading: Dhika says she knows and trusts him, and that he has proved it. Her stated reason is his “its just hands” response. Chotu does not understand what he proved; no general permission is asserted.

bond_beats.title: His first crush as distinct from earlier appreciation

bond_beats.reading: He waits seated in the hall. Alone at the bathroom mirror, she recalls the earlier bend/night thoughts, removes her dupatta, becomes excited and wants to find whether he would look.

bond_beats.title: Her uncovered return and his different explanation
bond_beats.reading: She returns without dupatta. He sees it but thinks she forgot it in the bedroom/bathroom; he does not know her private motivation.

He always brought a chocolate to Pappu whenever he came.

Chotu was happy to be in the presence of her and he would drink tea and play with Pappu 2 mins and leave. Over the months, the two got closer and she thought Chotu like her brother.
